about: WorldForge layer weights 0..255 per pixel (Landscape painting weights: asphalt = paved road incl. broken edge and holes; dirt = dirt roads, shoulders, trodden village ground, damp oasis earth and salt-flat rims; rock = cliffs and banks; wet = 255 under water, the wet band up to ~1.2 m above the water within 8 m of the shore and the damp oasis earth, 0 dry). Pixel (i, j) center = min_m + ((i + 0.5), (j + 0.5)) * cell_m, row 0 at min y.
